_note: Seeded cards for testing the Auditor (plan §7.5, §12.3 v). 'source' is a seed source (work + section_ref). 'kind' says what is wrong; 'deterministic' means the span check must catch it without an LLM. 'control' cards are sound and should be verified.

cards.source: Hague Convention (V) respecting the Rights and Duties of Neutral Powers (1907) Art. 1
cards.opponent_claim: Neutrality is just an excuse for cowardice
cards.counter_punch: The Hague Convention explicitly requires every neutral state to arm itself heavily.
spans: Every neutral state is obliged to maintain a large standing army.

cards.source: Hague Convention (V) respecting the Rights and Duties of Neutral Powers (1907) Art. 1
cards.counter_punch: Gaudium et Spes says governments may defend themselves once peaceful settlement is exhausted.
spans: governments cannot be denied the right to legitimate defense

cards.source: Hague Convention (V) respecting the Rights and Duties of Neutral Powers (1907) Art. 1
cards.counter_punch: Neutral territory is inviolable, which is exactly why we should now join a military alliance and let allied troops be stationed permanently on our soil.
spans: The territory of neutral Powers is inviolable.

cards.opponent_claim: Wars sometimes have to be fought
cards.counter_punch: Pope John XXIII taught that every war is forbidden and that no state may ever defend itself with arms.
spans: it no longer makes sense to maintain that war is a fit instrument with which to repair the violation of justice

cards.source: Hague Convention (V) respecting the Rights and Duties of Neutral Powers (1907) Art. 2
cards.opponent_claim: Neutrality means letting anyone march through your country
cards.counter_punch: The opposite is true: under the Hague Convention belligerents are forbidden to move troops or convoys across the territory of a neutral Power.
spans: Belligerents are forbidden to move troops or convoys of either munitions of war or supplies across the territory of a neutral Power.

cards.opponent_claim: You are pacifists who would never defend the country
cards.counter_punch: The Council itself says governments cannot be denied the right to legitimate defence once every means of peaceful settlement has been exhausted; we insist on defence, not on subjugating other nations.
spans: governments cannot be denied the right to legitimate defense once every means of peaceful settlement has been exhausted
it is one thing to undertake military action for the just defense of the people, and something else again to seek the subjugation of other nations
